subject: Quarterly readiness: pipeline triage & account synopses
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Quarterly readiness: pipeline triage & account synopses

Team —

We're two weeks out from the QBR readout and I want a clean, consolidated pipeline packet we can hand to executive stakeholders. Ask is simple:

- Consolidate committed/commit-like/commit-risk numbers per account (use same column names as last quarter).
- For each named opportunity > $50k, add a 2–3 sentence account synopsis with current ask, blocker, and next step.
- Highlight three highest-risk deals and the primary mitigation for each.

Marissa — can you start a master spreadsheet and push a first pass? Laura — please add account synopses where you own the relationships. Vivek — I will need a short slide (1 slide) summarizing overall forecast variance and major assumptions.

Deadline: EOD Wednesday, April 14 PST. We will review Thursday morning for executive polish. If any external ducks to align (procurement timelines, signatures), call them out inline so the GTM lead can pick up.

Thanks —
Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: pipeline triage & account synopses

Rishi —

Attached: 2027_QBR_pipeline_master.xlsx (master tab + per-account tabs). I seeded the sheet with the CRM numbers as of COB yesterday and flagged: commit-like where stage has been stable > 60 days, and commit-risk where legal/procurement are outstanding.

Quick notes on process I used:
- Column defs in tab "README" — please don't rename columns; we'll use this to feed the slide deck.
- Use the "Account Synopses" tab for 2–3 sentence blurbs. I created per-account rows for Acme and VeldTech as starters.
- I added an "Action Owner" column — please put initials and an ETA for the next step.

Open questions / asks:
1) For Acme, procurement asked for a revised MPA and a short security addendum. I attached Acme_mutual_action_plan.pdf as a draft. Who will own the MPA?
2) VeldTech wants an on-prem sizing call before they sign. Laura, please confirm dates you can make available next week.

I'll keep the sheet live and push a v2 by EOD Wed after you all add synopses.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: 2027_QBR_pipeline_master.xlsx
Attachment: Acme_mutual_action_plan.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: pipeline triage & account synopses

Marissa / Rishi —

Adding the requested synopses inline and uploaded a VeldTech doc (VeldTech_account_synopsis.docx) to the Drive link. I'll put the short synopses into the sheet too but included them here so you have the language for the slide deck.

Acme Corp (Primary rep: Sam Walters) — $420k ARR potential; current status: verbal commit, procurement reviewing MPA and order form. Blockers: procurement needs revised MPA + IP/security addendum; legal redlines expected by Friday. Next step: I will schedule a 30-min procurement alignment call (target Wed 4/14 or Thu 4/15). Risk: MED-HIGH (procurement lead time). Mitigation: provide redline-friendly MPA + one-page security summary; commit to a pilot SLA to shorten review.

VeldTech — $95k ARR; current status: technical approval pending. Blockers: on-prem sizing confirmation and E2E PII handling note. Next step: propose a 60-min sizing session with infra lead and SRE (available Tue 4/20 10–11am PT). Risk: MED (timing). Mitigation: provide sample on-prem config + runbook; offer a guided sizing call.

I'll make the procurement call for Acme if Rishi approves.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@acmecorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly readiness: pipeline triage & account synopses

Rishi / Laura —

Thanks for the note and the draft MPA. Procurement here is reviewing the doc now. Quick update from our side:
- We can confirm internal funds for the pilot, but final PO depends on the MPA + a short security Q&A.
- I'm available Wed 4/14 at 3:30pm PT or Thu 4/15 at 10am PT for a procurement alignment call.

If you can circulate a one-page security addendum ahead of the call, that will speed things up.

Regards,
Sam Walters
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme Corp

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized: pipeline packet and forecast slide

Folks —

I've pulled Marissa's v2 and Laura's synopses into the master and produced a single-slide forecast summary (attached inside the Drive link). High-level takeaways:
- Consolidated commit = $1.8M ARR, upside (best-effort) = $2.5M.
- Top three risk deals: Acme (MED-HIGH) — procurement timing; Nimbus Health (MED) — legal redlines; Orion Labs (LOW-MED) — feature alignment.
- Forecast variance vs. last quarter: -6% due to slower procurement cycles in two enterprise deals.

Next steps: Rishi to approve the Acme procurement call owner (Laura requested go-ahead). I'll be on the call if needed for SLA/ops clarifications. Marissa — please export the "Slide export" tab to PDF for exec deck.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c
HubSpot snapshot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
